SIT Report Links Temple Employee to Ram Temple Donation Theft

A Special Investigation Team (SIT) report has identified Avinash Shukla, an employee of the Ram Temple, as the prime accused in a case of alleged theft from donation boxes. The report also highlighted security lapses within the temple premises. The findings are expected to guide the next steps in the investigation.
